title: From Airspace Degradation to Deconfliction: Predicting Safety-Critical Traffic States through the Evolution of Multiscale Complexity Metrics
summary: Deconfliction events have distinguishable evolving traffic-complexity patterns versus conflict-free situations, detectable up to about six minutes before clearance; best reported accuracy is about 67% at informative spatial scales. The paper compares Random Forest, Gradient Boosting and SVM, uses repeated 10-fold cross-validation, and reports robustness checks across traffic loads and sectors. No independent external replication is reported; the observed association does not establish causality or operational readiness.
ai_technology: Supervised ML classifiers compare features from operational air-traffic records to identify traffic states associated with later deconfliction.
